label: OpenRouter
description: One key for hundreds of models
agentGuide: Base path /api/v1, OpenAI-shaped, one key for hundreds of models. Chat: POST /chat/completions {"model": "openai/gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [...]} (model ids are provider/name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4, google/gemini-2.5-flash, meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct, deepseek/deepseek-chat; "openrouter/auto" picks one). Models and prices: GET /models (data[].id, pricing.prompt per token, context_length). The key's balance and limits: GET /auth/key. Credits: GET /credits. A generation's cost: GET /generation?id=<id>. Free models end with :free. Every call is billed to the key. The key is set by Allkin.
